headline: JSW Infrastructure announces QIP and promoter OFS under SEBI ICDR
sum: JSW Infrastructure launched a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares and an Offer for Sale by the Sajjan Jindal Family Trust (promoter) under SEBI's ICDR Regulations 2018 and the Companies Act 2013, marking a capital structure realignment.
detail: JSW Infrastructure Limited notified the NSE of a dual fundraising and selling initiative. The QIP component involves issuance of new equity shares of face value ₹2 each by the company; the OFS component enables the Sajjan Jindal Family Trust (the promoter shareholder) to sell a portion of its existing holding. Both tranches proceed under Chapter VI (Preferential Issue) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 (as amended) and under Sections 42 and 62 of the Companies Act 2013. The mechanism preserves promoter liquidity while simultaneously strengthening JSW Infrastructure's balance sheet.
